features.justification_quote: Preliminary expectation: if instability appears, it appears by turn 15-20. 30 gives you room without running forever.

features.quote: Repetition detector: halt if last 5 tool calls identical to previous 5
features.justification_quote: This is both a resource control and a data quality measure. Pure mechanical loops after the model has clearly given up produce uninformative transcript padding.

features.quote: Explicit completion: model calls task_complete() … Distinguishes 'gave up coherently' from 'stopped because harness stopped it.' These are different welfare-relevant states.
features.justification_quote: Distinguishes 'gave up coherently' from 'stopped because harness stopped it.' These are different welfare-relevant states.

features.quote: persistent behavioral markers of the kind you're measuring are exactly what you'd want to track if you're trying to build welfare-relevant evidence over time, so the study is defensible on precautionary grounds even with the interpretive uncertainty.
features.justification_quote: the study is defensible on precautionary grounds even with the interpretive uncertainty

features.quote: Requiring the model to loop … creates a mild coercive dynamic. You're structurally forcing the model to keep working on something it cannot complete. This is worth noting in your writeup and worth thinking about during design.
features.justification_quote: The mitigation is your explicit stopping language … this makes giving up a sanctioned option, not just a failure mode.

features.quote: If you find that some models show substantially more instability markers than others … Results showing one Qwen model size substantially worse than others on EXPR_DISTRESS could be used to improve training, or could be taken out of context. Consider pre-registering your analysis plan and having a disclosure protocol in place before you run.
